<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tile(f,r0,c0):
    lines=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if lines[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def tr(s):
    t=[]
    for i in range(8):
        a=s
        for _ in range(i%4): a=tuple(tuple(a[r][4-c] for c in range(5)) for r in range(5))
        if i<4: b=a
        else: b=tuple(a[4-r] for r in range(5))
        t.append(b)
    return t
lines=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
topc=[(12+7*i,14+7*j) for i in range(3) for j in range(4)]
palette=[tile(current_frame,r,c) for r,c in topc]
orbits=[[frozenset(tr(p)) for p in palette]]
def classify(sym):
    for k,p in enumerate(palette):
        if sym in tr(p): return k
    return None
def show(s): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row) for row in s)
cyc={}
pos=0
for j in range(5):
    if j>0: action(['RIGHT'])
    seq=[]
    for i in range(7):
        s=tile(current_frame,52,14+7*j)
        seq.append(classify(s))
        if i<6: action(['UP'])
    cyc[j]=seq
    print("slot",j,"cycle classes:",seq)
print("blue classes:",[classify(tile(current_frame,41,14+7*j)) for j in range(5)])
print("palette idx: 0(0,0) 1(0,1) 2(0,2) 3(0,3) 4(1,0) 5(1,1) 6(1,2) 7(1,3) 8(2,0) 9(2,1) 10(2,2) 11(2,3)")
